entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. This is Charlie with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF90210.

Okay, I can definitely help with that. Let me just pull that up... I see the order for the ProFit Jersey. Just to be sure I'm resolving this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong size. It's just too tight. I need to exchange it or return it. Can you do that, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. I see here the delivery was 34 days ago, and that jersey has a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund or an exchange.
Good. I just want the refund. Process that.

No problem at all. I have processed the return authorization. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next five minutes. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience of receiving the wrong size, I've gone ahead and added a credit for free two-day shipping to your account for your next order.
Okay, that's fine. So the label is coming to my email?
That's correct. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
